    secs[m.group(1)] = m.group(0)
def hunklist(sec):
    lines = sec.split('\n')
    i = 0
    while not lines[i].startswith('@@'):
        i += 1
    body = '\n'.join(lines[i:]).rstrip('\n') + '\n'
    # split into individual hunks
    parts = re.split(r'(?m)^(?=@@ )', body)
    return [p for p in parts if p.strip()]

import re
gen = open('generated.patch', encoding='utf-8').read()
# split generated into per-file sections
secs = {}
for m in re.finditer(r'^diff --git a/(\S+) b/\S+\n(.*?)(?=^diff --git |\Z)', gen, re.M | re.S):
    secs[m.group(1)] = m.group(0)
def hunks(sec):
    # drop the diff/index/--- /+++ header lines, return the hunk body
    lines = sec.split('\n')
    i = 0
    while not lines[i].startswith('@@'):
        i += 1
    return '\n'.join(lines[i:])

orig = open('/home/user/Deepresearch.se/pygram/variant/patches/0001-pygram-port.patch', encoding='utf-8').read()

# 1. main.c: insert the heap hunk before the "@@ -105,6 +118,16 @@" hunk
mark = "@@ -105,6 +118,16 @@ static int handle_uncaught_exception(mp_obj_base_t *exc) {"
assert orig.count(mark) == 1
main_h = hunks(secs['ports/unix/main.c']).rstrip('\n') + '\n'
out = orig.replace(mark, main_h + mark)

# 2. modbuiltins.c: append its hunk at end of that section
mark = "diff --git a/py/objdict.c b/py/objdict.c"
assert out.count(mark) == 1
mb_h = hunks(secs['py/modbuiltins.c']).rstrip('\n') + '\n'
out = out.replace(mark, mb_h + mark)

# 3. objexcept.c: append its two hunks at end of that section
mark = "diff --git a/py/objfloat.c b/py/objfloat.c"
assert out.count(mark) == 1
oe_h = hunks(secs['py/objexcept.c']).rstrip('\n') + '\n'
out = out.replace(mark, oe_h + mark)

# 4. obj.h: whole new section appended at the end
out = out.rstrip('\n') + '\n' + secs['py/obj.h'].rstrip('\n') + '\n'

open('merged.patch', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(out)
print('merged.patch written', len(out))

def rw(p, f):
    s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read(); s2=f(s); assert s2!=s, p; open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s2)
old_block = """    MP_DEFINE_EXCEPTION(FileNotFoundError, OSError)
    MP_DEFINE_EXCEPTION(FileExistsError, OSError)
    MP_DEFINE_EXCEPTION(PermissionError, OSError)
    MP_DEFINE_EXCEPTION(IsADirectoryError, OSError)
    MP_DEFINE_EXCEPTION(NotADirectoryError, OSError)
    #endif
"""
rw('py/objexcept.c', lambda s: s.replace(old_block, "    MP_DEFINE_EXCEPTION(FileNotFoundError, OSError)\n    #endif\n"))

""", ""))
